chunks: And this (Qur'an) is a revelation from the Lord of all the worlds,
ai.seo_question: Who is the source of the Qur'an's revelation according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a foundational assertion of the Qur'an's divine provenance, countering the Meccan polytheists' claims that the Prophet Muhammad was merely a poet or madman. Shia exegesis highlights 'Rabb al-'Alamin' (Lord of the Worlds) to emphasize the universal scope of this revelation, linking it to the concept of Tawhid and the prophetic mission as a mercy for all creation.
